#   status  open: an open record, its owner in `who`, the round it first went over in `since`
#           gap: a known gap, the place it was ruled in `who`
#           note: a note alone; the row reads NEW or UNOWNED as a row with no entry does
#   note    shown beside the status, or `-`
# A row with no open record or gap reads NEW in the first round it is over and UNOWNED after.
